name: core.openwop.connections.ucp-reference-merchant
description: UCP reference-merchant connection pack (RFC 0095) — declares the TARGET shape of a reach:'mcp' merchant the UCP BUYER shops to validate the ucp.<op> convention (ADR 0258/0260): a bearer-auth MCP server exposing the tools ucp.discover / ucp.search / ucp.checkout / ucp.order-status, each returning a BARE structured JSON result (no content wrapper). Category is `other`: the normative `category` enum has no `commerce-merchant` value and the buyer resolves by provider `id`, not category — no wire/RFC change. The `url` here is a placeholder for a REAL merchant (https-only per RFC 0095 §B.5); the in-repo DEMO merchant is wired instead by the `ucp-reference-merchant` example-data seeder (ADR 0260), which registers a loopback dev route (POST /v1/host/openwop-app/dev/ucp-merchant/mcp, enabled by OPENWOP_UCP_REF_MERCHANT_ENABLED) and a workspace Connection so the buyer can be pointed at it. The demo merchant moves NO money (checkout creates a PENDING, unpaid order). Carries NO secret (ADR 0024 §7).
